claims.claim: CF, JERA and Mitsui broke ground August 26 on Blue Point One, a 1.4M-tonne-per-year low-carbon ammonia plant targeted for 2029; CF owns 40% and is also investing $550M in shared scalable infrastructure.

risks.risk: Blue Point is a multiyear capital project with construction, carbon-sequestration, offtake and policy execution risk before expected 2029 production.

unknowns.unknown: Long-run premium realization for low-carbon ammonia and final project returns remain uncertain.

claims.claim: CF reported Q2 2026 net earnings of $727M and adjusted EBITDA of $1.19B versus $761M a year earlier; production reached 98% of available ammonia capacity in H1 and Blue Point received construction permits in July.

risks.risk: Q2 sales volumes were 15% lower year over year and the Yazoo City outage reduced product availability; nitrogen earnings remain exposed to gas costs and global supply-demand swings.

contradictions.contradiction: Strong earnings and pricing coexist with materially lower sales volumes, partly reflecting outage and customer timing effects.

unknowns.unknown: Normalization of nitrogen pricing after conflict-related supply disruptions is uncertain.
